title: 🖐️ Retro Player / One Hand + Carried Pet

accepted_baseline.label: Persistent low-res first-person scene
preserve: one coherent generated photographic hand identity

current_candidate.summary: V10 removes the extra hand-system complexity: one lower-right player hand only, one PET sequence only, no left/right alternation, no front-actor hand runtime, and a handless carried pet with only idle + react behavior.

open_feedback: Verify the published V10 reads as exactly one owned first-person hand from the lower-right.
Verify no frame in the PET sequence flips to the opposite side or reads as a palm aimed back at the camera.
Verify the carried pet has no human hands and only idles/reacts.
Tune only the hand reach distance and pet size if real visual feedback requires it; do not add new actions before acceptance.
